verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own materials state the core story directly: share a booking link, connect your calendars, and let people pick a time without the back-and-forth. Live availability is backed by calendar conflict checking, schedules and slot computation, and a community user confirms it works for a recruiter booking calendar. One older hands-on report said available hours seemed capped at 9am–5pm, which limits but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the public booking-page experience itself (beyond a marketing line and API references), and independent confirmation that availability windows are fully flexible.

support.subject: As a founder, I can share a booking link where invitees pick a time from my live availability — no back-and-forth email
